headline: Bello gets tagged in Atlanta as the local nine drops another series
morning_brew: Brayan Bello had a rough afternoon down in Atlanta. Giving up seven earned runs over five innings is not going to win you many ballgames. The offense managed nine hits but only crossed the plate once, which is a recipe for a blowout. It is a long flight to Kansas City after a result like that. We need the starting rotation to give us a real chance to breathe instead of digging a hole in the first two frames.

Ryan Watson actually looked decent out of the pen, throwing three innings without surrendering a hit. It is a wicked strange line to give up a run without a hit, but he struck out four and kept things moving. The team sits at nineteen wins and twenty-seven losses right now. We are searching for some consistency before the squad heads back to Fenway later this week. This road trip has been a struggle and the bats need to wake up.

Off the field, the news is a bit lighter with the football team. Nancy Meier is retiring after a legendary run with the organization, and you have to respect that kind of loyalty. Meanwhile, Tom Brady is out there walking the catwalk in New York, which is certainly a choice. Back at the Hub, we are just waiting for some actual roster moves to help the winter teams get back to the mountain. It is quiet around the Garden these days.

news_digest.headline: Patriots' longest-tenured employee, Nancy Meier, to retire
news_digest.dans_take: Respect to a lifer who saw all the rings and kept the gears turning behind the scenes.

news_digest.headline: Tom Brady makes catwalk debut at Gucci event in Times Square
news_digest.dans_take: The man is living his best life but I would rather see him under center than on a runway.

news_digest.headline: NBA offseason: Draft, free agency, trade targets for eliminated teams
news_digest.dans_take: The front office has a lot of work to do if they want to avoid another early exit.
